done_when: When a recorded agent's process id now belongs to a different process, the lane keeps the run while its Forge process is alive, so the next agent start for that item goes ahead

findings.body: Raise: Test. The regression test modifies only the Claude stub and starts a newly created client repo. It does not exercise the next-agent start through Codex or in a repo adopted on an earlier release, although the repository rules require both adapters and both client histories. The changed older-queue test checks `forge stop`, not whether the next agent starts. Those paths could break while the named proof remains green.
findings.title: Not done: test PID reuse through Codex and an upgraded client

why: A run can be dropped from the machine line when its agent's process id is reused by another process, so the next agent start for that item is refused with 'This run was stopped'
